summary: Frontend-only test of the 3 legal pages fix. All 5 requested scenarios PASSED: /mentions-legales renders the real MentionsLegales page (data-testid page-mentions-legales) with h1 'Mentions légales' and sections Éditeur/Hébergement/Propriété intellectuelle (not NotFound). /confidentialite renders 'Politique de confidentialité' with sections Données collectées / Vos droits / Cookies. /cgv renders 'Conditions générales d'utilisation et de vente' with sections Abonnements et prix / Droit de rétractation. All 3 footer links (footer-link-mentions, footer-link-confidentialite, footer-link-cgv) are visible on the home page and navigate to the correct legal pages. Non-regression verified: /url-bidon-xyz still shows the NotFound 404 page ('Cette page n'existe pas') and none of the legal page testids appear. Route order in App.js is correct (legal routes declared BEFORE path='*').
critical_code_review_comments: LegalPages.jsx contains placeholders '[À COMPLÉTER — ...]' for SAS/EI, siège social, SIRET, TVA, directeur de la publication. These must be filled with real legal information before enabling Google Ads (mandatory under French LCEN law for a commercial site).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal pages (/mentions-legales, /confidentialite, /cgv) are live and reachable both by direct URL and via footer links. NotFound regression intact. Only remaining action is business content: complete the '[À COMPLÉTER]' placeholders in MentionsLegales (SIRET, forme juridique, adresse, directeur publication) before publishing Google Ads.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — verification pass only. Original visual-404 on /mentions-legales was caused by absence of the route; fix (adding routes /mentions-legales, /confidentialite, /cgv BEFORE the catch-all path='*' in App.js and exporting the three pages from /app/frontend/src/pages/LegalPages.jsx, plus footer links in Nav.jsx) is confirmed working.
